items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Baby Daz was… and a guy named Curry.

ctx.x: Zuly, yes. Zuly was a senior citizen. He was… he‟s in Louis era. That‟s the Hot Five. He was Louie‟s drummer. But Louie to the day he died… TAYLOR; Now who was before Zuly? Was it Baby Daz maybe?
Baby Daz was… and a guy named Curry.
